analyst_view.overall: Roma are unbeaten in Serie A with the league's best attack, but they lost 3-2 at Manchester United on Tuesday after leading 2-0, and one report says only 16 outfield players are available. Svilar is out, Gollini is a late call with a back problem, and Dybala and Manu Koné are unlikely to feature. Sassuolo have lost four league games in a row and have the worst defence, and they are without Domenico Berardi, who is missing from the site's list.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. Roma come in tired and short of bodies, and Sassuolo lose their main creator Berardi, which the numbers don't count. Sassuolo's leaky defence keeps this lean mild.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. Roma should dominate territory as the numbers expect, and we found nothing to change that.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.1 cards. We found nothing on referee Marco Di Bello or any tension between the sides, so we stay level.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.3 shots. Roma's depleted squad pulls one way and Sassuolo's poor defending the other, so we stay with the numbers.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target. Without Dybala and with Sassuolo's attack weakened by Berardi's absence, we lean slightly lower on chances worked into shots on target.
